negative_irritation_triggers: Speculative statements without running live verification tools.
Violating explicit constraints (e.g. applying to TCS, adding Golang).
Sloppy document formatting (orphan lines on resume page 3).
Verbose chat reporting that wastes LLM tokens.
Repetitive failure loops (e.g. portal page reloads).
positive_satisfaction_drivers: Empirical verification presented with concrete data (PDF page count: 2, commit SHA, clean status).
Proactive root-cause fixes that bypass brittle portal quirks.
Deep cognitive synthesis that captures the user exact intent and standards.
